note: P4363 (Pro 30:6) — do not add to his words, lest he rebuke you and you be found a liar.

dims.v: presumption — tampering with revelation, exposed as falsehood
the being found a liar for adding to God's words — the presumption that tampers with or supplements divine revelation, exposed as falsehood when God rebukes it
(the true word it dares to add to)
the arrogance of amending God's flawless word, unmasked as a lie

kazab (lie/falsehood) — 'do not add to his words, lest he rebuke you and you be found a LIAR' (30:6); to supplement or tamper with God's flawless word is presumption that God exposes as falsehood. Revelation is not ours to amend (cf Deut 4:2; Rev 22:18-19).
